decisions.reason: As a multi-item facial care line with its own page over two years, A reflects a visible and broader commitment in the firm's core natural skincare business, so management is likely to persist with it unless results clearly deteriorate.

B remains on the website across 2023 and 2024 and fits the established facial-care range, so despite lower visibility than A the firm is likely to keep backing it as a justifiable adjacent innovation.

Because D was only launched in 2024 and is close to the core offer, management can readily attribute any weak early results to a normal ramp-up period and is therefore more likely to continue than to withdraw it quickly.
